{{Top|leg}}
The '''Office of Occupation and Law''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] occupation of the world. Due to a strict curfew, residents of the planet had to be in their homes from sundown to sunrise; residents needing to be out during this period required appropriate permits issued by the Office of Occupation and Law.
